description:
Cast Eagle of Deliverance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Eagle of Deliverance spell three times.
Resolve the first Eagle of Deliverance spell.
When the Eagle of Deliverance token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams
uses.cardState: with two indestructible counters on it
